required_facts_checked: Planning begins interactively in Streamlit with a topic, size and Gemini 3 Pro Preview chat.
Gemini refines the existing outline using the current plan and new feedback.
The Ready - Create Structured Plan step produces plan.yaml from a Pydantic BookPlan schema.
The same plan is used by writing, audio, cover and publishing steps.
Chapters are generated from specifications and progress markers rather than full prior chapter text.
The repository has section-based and chapter-based implementations.
Existing artifacts are skipped on reruns, and a _ready sentinel marks completion.
Cost is tracked during planning and writing.
The pipeline produces audio, EPUB and KDP artifacts, but publishing files do not guarantee sales.
A fireworks example produced 21 chapters in about 45 minutes for roughly $4 using Gemini 3 Pro.
unsupported_claims_removed: Removed claims that the plan guarantees narrative quality or commercial success.
Removed unsupported fixed cost estimates beyond the documented fireworks example.
substantive_edits: Rewrote the pipeline as a teaching explanation from interactive planning through chapter execution, audio and publishing.
Explained plan.yaml as the shared interface between stages and preserved resumability details.
Kept the cost, artifact and commercial limitations explicit.
